newsitem.title: UK: Bradford wool market firmer, but business subdued.
newsitem.headline: Bradford wool market firmer, but business subdued.

text.p: Little new business was reported and the rise in world prices was seen led by Japan rather than Europe, where there were several holidays.
But the view that the season would end in June with prices no more than steady has been abandoned and rising prices next season are seen as more likely.
Currency changes for sterling against the Australian dollar tend to offset a little of the rise in the wool price, but even where quoted increases are small, a firmer attitude applies.
